svg.title: From the car to the manual gearbox
svg.desc: The standard six-speed manual sits behind the 2010 2.9 engine. Its clutch faces the engine; the final drive sends torque sideways to the rear wheels. Follow engine torque through the flywheel, single dry clutch and gearbox. The cabin lever selects a synchroniser through cables; a separate hydraulic release acts on the clutch. Numbered parts: 1 Engine interface; 2 Dual-mass flywheel; 3 Dry clutch; 4 Clutch release; 5 Gearbox and input; 6 Synchroniser and fork; 7 Lever and cables; 8 Final drive and shafts. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
